name: slice N's accepted-criteria set is a STRICT SUPERSET of slice N-1's — verified deterministically in code; a shrinking proposal is REJECTED, never silently widened (PHASE-56 W-2, R-20)
description: PHASE-56 W-2, ruling R-20. The built workspace is per-PROJECT while the manifest and test plan are per-LOOP, so a slice-2 scoped spec that dropped slice-1's acceptance criteria would make the materializer regenerate the entry file from a specification that no longer describes slice 1 — silently deleting working, owner-accepted functionality. The invariant is therefore enforced by validateNextSliceScope in code and NEVER trusted to the provider. Asserts, at unit level: an equal set is rejected (STRICT superset required), a dropped criterion is rejected, a dropped FILE is rejected, and a genuine growth is accepted; the rejection is typed and names the offending ids. Asserts, at engine level: the scope the engine actually constructs passes the invariant, is cumulative, and carries every slice-1 criterion and file forward.
